@@ -477,0 +477,5 @@
+// INCLUDE_APPS specifies whether the "apps" directory is part of the build.
+// When disabled, the "apps", "appsjar" and "clean" tasks will not compile or clean the "apps" directory.
+defineProperty("INCLUDE_APPS", "true")
+ext.IS_INCLUDE_APPS = Boolean.parseBoolean(INCLUDE_APPS)

@@ -75,0 +75,7 @@
+# Specifies whether the applications in the "apps" directory are built or cleaned.
+# They are built with a separate Ant based build,
+# which is not needed to build or test the JavaFX modules themselves.
+# Uncomment this flag in order to no build and clean the apps.
+
+#INCLUDE_APPS = false
